hon.A: Same soft hand-painted storybook style, same round gold-rimmed medallion and same chibi proportions as the reference, but the person is now a young CONSORT (imperial concubine) of the inner palace, a graceful woman about twenty-two with a soft pretty face, black hair in a neat elegant bun with two gold hairpins, a small pearl hair ornament and one small pink flower (no crown, no phoenix), a jade green (#6FAE92) silk robe with an ivory (#F1E6D2) collar and light gold embroidery at the shoulders. The medallion disc is now dusty plum-wine instead of red. Her face and pose: cold 'hmph' face turned away, chin up, eyes closed, one hand raised palm out small at chest height. Light posture only: the other hand resting at the bottom of the medallion just inside the gold rim; no outstretched arm, no big gesture. Both eyes looking together. Everything kept INSIDE the round medallion, the medallion drawn a bit smaller and centred so there is empty space around it. Bare earlobes, no earrings. Whole picture on a flat pure chroma green (#00FF00) background outside the medallion, nothing else, no text.
